name: Docsy
tagline: Read versioned library documentation with verifiable source links.
description: Docsy is a free, hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server for developer documentation. Resolve package and framework library IDs, retrieve focused version-specific documentation and code examples, list indexed versions, search public documentation, and fetch results by stable ID. Five read-only tools are available without an API key. The public GitHub repository contains the MIT-licensed client plugin; the hosted crawler and indexing backend remain managed rather than open source.

install.notes: Public read-only MCP service. No authentication or local runtime required.
